title: Size After Pair Encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $r$ be a finite bit string, and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $2n+2+|r|$ inputs, gates in topological order, and a valid output vertex. If circuit size is the number of inputs plus the number of gates, then wiring $C$ to the pair encoding of an $n$-bit input and $r$ produces a circuit of size $n+\operatorname{size}(C)$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ has gates in topological order with each gate reading only earlier vertices
